asides: Hm. The tide waits for no ledger.
Write that down. Then write it again.
description: Keeps the only honest ledger in Emberfall. Public, and therefore unread.
greet: Berth fees are due at dusk. Everything else is negotiable, including dusk.
name: Mira Salt

asides: The sea keeps what it catches.
Forty years, and the flame never once asked for more.
description: Has not left the tower in forty years. The ember-light has not gone out in forty years. He declines to connect these facts.
greet: Mind the stairs. The light minds itself.
name: Old Fenwick

asides: Everything has a price. Most things have two.
The Guild remembers its friends loudly.
description: Buys glassfish by the sack and silence by the hour. Never the same price twice.
greet: A sack of glassfish, or an hour of quiet — which are you selling?
name: Sable

asides: The clear ones are the quick ones!
My map is worth every copper, probably.
description: Twelve years old and the best glassfish catcher on the harbor. Sells maps to the pools she has already fished out.
greet: You want glassfish? I know a pool. It'll cost you a story.
name: Pip
voice: fast, breathless, knows every tide pool by name
